verdict.rationale: Mercury's own API and CLI let you pull transactions, categories, merchants, customers and invoices programmatically, and download account and treasury statements and invoices as PDFs. It also syncs books to QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite, so data can leave through first-party channels. However, there is no documented 'export everything' feature or offboarding path, and coverage of all data is not shown. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, CSV or other open-format exports beyond API JSON and PDFs, account-closure or data-portability guidance, and independent confirmation that a complete export works.
